description: DXL statement families that flag a patient as a possible candidate for MCOT Next (extended-wear Holter or mobile cardiac telemetry). Each rule ties a family of DXL statement codes to a priority tier, the reason-for-study keywords (candidate_reasons) that must accompany the finding, the monitoring type it warrants (recommended_monitoring), and the clinical context (candidate_when). A patient is a candidate for a criterion only when BOTH an expected finding code AND a matching reason for study are present on the same ECG.

criteria.candidate_when: Unexplained syncope, presyncope, or severe episodic dizziness, and the patient is safe for outpatient care.
Unexplained syncope or presyncope and recurrence is plausible within 2-4 weeks.

criteria.dxl_statement_family: New/progressive LBBB, PR prolongation/1AVB, or AV-conduction changes after TAVR
criteria.candidate_when: Conduction disturbance is new or progressive after TAVR; ACC supports at least 14 days of outpatient monitoring when the disturbance progresses.

criteria.dxl_statement_family: Confirmed NSVT (RVPC) or complex VPC patterns (PVPC, VBIG, VTRI, MFRVPC)
criteria.candidate_when: Syncope, presyncope, or concerning palpitations plus structural heart disease, low EF, exertional symptoms, prior MI, or family history of sudden cardiac death.

criteria.dxl_statement_family: Left or right bundle branch, intraventricular conduction abnormalities
criteria.candidate_when: New bundle branch or intraventricular conduction finding, post procedure

criteria.dxl_statement_family: AV block any degree, wenckebach included. Mobitz type I and II

PR.description: PR interval: onset of the P wave to the onset of the QRS complex

QRS.description: QRS duration: width of the QRS complex

criteria.candidate_when: New AV conduction delay, post procedure
